name: dea-metamodel-diagram-tokens
description: Design tokens for the OpenDEAM metamodel diagram (viewer/metamodel.svg). Every diagram regeneration consumes these tokens — generate_puml.py (PlantUML source) and inject_svg_attributes.py (SVG post-processing) MUST read this file and MUST NOT hardcode design values. Design principle (locked 2026-08-15, variant 'C2'): the diagram has no canvas of its own — the SVG background is transparent and inherits the page background; packages carry the layer's dark color with a layer-accent stroke; relationship labels are small italic grey with no outline/halo; attribute text is light grey on the dark entity fill. Per-layer accent and dark colors are NOT stored here — they cascade from the OpenDEAM root model via viewer/entity-graph.json (layers[].color / layers[].dark_color). When the model adds a layer or package, its colors flow through automatically; extend the 'dimension' token only for new cross-cutting dimensions.

entity.comment: stereotype badge fill = layer accent blended into entity.fill at stereotype_blend_alpha (computed deterministically at injection time). Entity stroke, accent bar, badge stroke and visibility dots all use the layer accent from entity-graph.json.

relationship_label.comment: No outline/halo and no label background — labels sit directly on the page background. font_size is enforced in the PUML (skinparam arrow FontSize) and re-enforced during injection.

package.comment: fill/stroke/title resolve per package from entity-graph.json: layers[].dark_color for fill, layers[].color for stroke and title. 'layer-dark'/'layer-accent' are symbolic references, not literal colors.

dimension.comment: Cross-cutting dimension packages (e.g. measurement, semantic) have no home layer; they use these neutral tokens instead of layer colors.
